title: A clear ending leaves a light beginning

captions.physics: Completing understood parts warmly and directly
captions.energy: Encompassing conversation within its actual limits
captions.emotions: Feeling lightness in a continuation unknown

meaning: You can directly complete an understood part and encompass conversation within actual limits, feeling lightness in an unknown continuation without immediately opening another subject.
text: On your Vishuddha, the Sun in the physical position appears in directly and warmly completing an understood part of conversation. The World in energy supports readiness to encompass the exchange within actual limits. The Fool in emotions brings lightness to a continuation still unknown. You can clearly name what was heard now without prescribing the next remark. A whole conclusion requires neither exhausting every subject nor preserving one way of talking.

For example, after discussing an unfamiliar expression comes “I understand now, thank you for explaining”. You can finish this question without immediately deciding what to discuss next. **An understandable conclusion leaves the next words a free beginning**. Lightness emerges: a pause seems no unfinished issue, and a new subject need not connect with the earlier one. Yet completion concerns the expression explained rather than every possible impression of conversation. Warmth remains without a special closing joke or a promise to continue tomorrow.

Difficulty arises if light continuation becomes necessary proof of a successful ending. A quiet pause seems empty and needs urgent filling. Constructive World energy helps see the fullness of the part already shared without compulsory additions. You can finish clearly without knowing the next question; freshness requires no constantly new content, while the absence of an immediate reply does not cancel what was heard or turn a warm conclusion into hidden unwillingness ever to talk again.
